steps.what: prepare a dedicated worktree at the ATTESTED frozen commit (the commit the freeze receipt names), never the development worktree
install the pinned harness (the files of the harness fingerprint the freeze receipt pins) into that worktree
fingerprint the installed harness and the loaded runtime and compare both with the receipts
inventory the capabilities on that source: every adapter, hook contract, guard and the catalogue (the -PlanOnly and dry-run forms)

prerequisites.neverFallBack: if a capability is missing or a hook contract changed the run stops with unsupported-source (exit 2) for the author; the harness never falls back to the old engine

recalibration (count budgets, the CPU quantum, the guards) on the frozen source
prerequisites.costing: none of this is in any runtime projection of this plan (they price the frozen commands only)

ig06.status: DEFERRED in the first round (not passed, not refuted); this is a proposal for when to implement and run it

proposal.implementWhen: after the frozen IG-S05 screen has been reviewed by the plan author (Fable) and the pack author (Astra), and after a separate budget approval for IG-S06 itself; the pre-freeze result (0 verified hits in 256 trials, native kinds included) is not the reason to compose anything
proposal.conditionalOnFrozenScreen: if the frozen screen still finds no variant with verified hits, IG-S06 composes a non-winning F1 default: ask the author whether to run it at all (a full-request frontier with zero grid yield is a cost measurement only)
proposal.developmentEstimate: 90-150 min of development by the pack author's estimate (check-list), separate from machine time
proposal.keepsFromTheFirstRound: the unchanged selection and budget hashes (selection.json 67420e10..., budgets f0a0c422...); both are re-derived on the frozen pilot first

confirmatory.note: two modes x 40 requests on each of the four frontier cells, NOT four modes x 40 (the controls and the frontier are the only confirmatory modes; native kinds and proposal-only are compared on the 40 SM2 grid clusters)

diagnostic.modes: N1, CA4, CQ1, CQ4 (CA4 = CQ4 on Killer and Greater-Than, one observation)

projection.label: PLANNING SCENARIOS with an INCOMPLETE upper bound: none of the three is a guaranteed ceiling of a whole IG-S06 run
projection.formula: confirmatory: for each cell and mode, requests x the cold wall of the IG-S02 attempts-w4 arm (native-mixed measured; selected frontier UNMEASURED, so priced at the native cost as the central figure); low: the frontier request priced native x (1 - s + s x r), s the IG-S07 sample share, r the F1/equal-weight-mix sample CPU ratio of IG-S05 (a Derived lower figure that credits the unmeasured saving); diagnostic: N1 and CQ1 at the IG-S02 serial wall, CA4 and CQ4 at the pooled wall; commands per phase: max(1, ceil(phase occupied / 258 s window)) for the confirmatory and the diagnostic phase separately; grace 45 s per command; guard scenario: 364 observations (320 confirmatory + 40 primary and 4 optional diagnostic), each its own command at the 180 s request guard plus the 60 s validation guard, plus the grace
omittedFromTheGuardScenario: the engine-free scheduler and composition tests (unwrapped, no machine charge expected)
startup, validation and cleanup beyond the two named guards
retries, resumed and failed attempts (each a command with its own grace)
dev checks and diagnostics outside the shard plan
the frontier phase-A work of a request that the 180 s guard does not bound separately
projection.uncertainty: the frontier request cost is unmeasured: the central figure assumes no saving, the low figure the formula; the guard scenario prices every observation at both guards but omits the components listed; a request that reaches the 180 s guard needs its own physical command
